Team —

Quick check-in on BrightByte (DEAL-7894) renewal cadence. Finance asked for a short, validated snapshot by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the Q4 bookings plan. There are three things I need from you:

1) Stage & commit sanity: confirm the current renewal stage in HubSpot and whether the ARR commit should be: committed / at-risk / upside. If at-risk, add a one-line reason.
2) Churn anchors: flag any churn signals (usage dip, exec change, POC delays, legal/ops blockers) and add an expected mitigation owner + ETA.
3) Contract readiness: confirm whether the attached proforma (PROFORMA_RENEWAL.docx) matches the commercial terms we discussed at the exec meeting.

Notes: BrightByte recently reduced query volume by ~18% MoM and procurement pushed for a consolidated renewal date (12/01). That change could push us into a split ARR recognition pattern — finance needs clarity. I attached the MUP schedule we received and a proforma draft.

Action items (please reply inline by EOD Wednesday):
- Laura: verify stage commit & procurement ask (is the 12/01 date firm?)
- Rishi: confirm pricing/discount tolerance and whether we have an approved playbook for this mid-term usage drop
- Marissa: update HubSpot with the final forecast note + attach the MUP schedule and reference doc link below

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-7894
Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-renewal-evidence

Thanks — a tight 2-3 line update per person will be enough.

– Diego
